scope: Owner-authorized two-update offset-versus-spatial fitting diagnostic; full-training authorization applies only after protected gain and a frozen trainable recipe are verified.
question: Does the uniform adapter response explain the local count shift, and can its centered spatial component improve dense/extreme errors without sparse/spatial harm?

architecture.per_level: Conv2d(2,4,3,padding1) -> GELU -> flatten36 -> Linear(36,3); 187 parameters x3 levels.
architecture.features: Unchanged frozen pretrained SAM2 native reference/query128/64/32 and geometry.
architecture.location: Residual adds to original three matching summaries before unchanged exemplar mean/max aggregation and decoder.
architecture.initialization: Fixed isolated construction seed2027, same adapter parameters in all arms, zero output projection/bias; base weights and initial predictions equal native pretrained A0.
architecture.original: Identical adapter graph multiplied by zero; 561 dormant parameters. Effective capacity equals original; active capacity is matched among the other three arms.
architecture.summary_residual: Repeat [adaptive score, mean, variance] three times to form9 values, plus native validity mask. No additional raw correspondence information.
architecture.ordered_parts: Prespecified primary: nine native ordered part scores plus supplied-boundary validity in a2x3x3 tensor per query location/exemplar.
architecture.permuted_parts: Same score/validity pairs under one fixed bijection, not information destruction; tests ordered part inductive bias. A network may learn around this permutation.
architecture.inference: Image features, native visual exemplars and their geometry only; no counts/points/masks/category labels.
architecture.frozen_summary: Identical summary_residual graph with original head/Adam states held fixed.
architecture.frozen_ordered: Primary: identical ordered_parts graph with original head/Adam states held fixed.

training.objective: Unchanged joint_objective: count + .25 regional + .5 conserved-blur +5 normalized marginal CDF.
training.base_optimizer: Restore authentic saved state age4536. Compute its gradients and global clip, then set base gradients None immediately before Adam.step; original weights/moments/age remain bitwise unchanged every step.
training.new_optimizer: Same AdamW hyperparameters, fresh zero moments/age0 for added parameters in every arm; separate parameter group.
training.clipping: Compute all base+adapter gradients and unchanged global norm1 first; mask base afterward. This preserves first-step adapter updates versus joint training.
training.RNG: Exact saved generator/CPU/CUDA states restored before every arm.
training.precision: CUDA BF16 forward/FP32 counts and losses, TF32off, 2CPU threads.
training.data: Only the first fixed batch8 from the unchanged schedule, once per ordered/summary input;16 optimization presentations. No new images, augmentation or seed.
training.compute: Two identical-capacity one-step probes. All19 endpoints use identical corresponding postupdate parameters; only forward activations are decomposed. This is not training through the centered operator.

readout.previously_seen: All readouts are source-fitting images seen by the pretrained checkpoint and reused for diagnostics. No independent validation claim.
readout.endpoints: Initial baseline +9 forward interventions for each input: full/mean/centered, their negative signs, and three equal-magnitude positive controls.19 endpoints x65=1235 query forwards.
readout.displacement_control: Activation norm control per image/level/active exemplar: all six positive components across both inputs shrink to their minimum L2 norm. Never amplify; zero components make scientific gate unevaluable.

gate.practical_gain: At least1% MAE reduction in each dense group against every reference, beyond numerical tolerance.
gate.count_protection: Overall MAE/RMSE/class-macro; sparse and both medium bins MAE/RMSE.
gate.spatial_protection: GAME1/2/3 and normalized blur in every populated stratum; >=1% normalized blur improvement overall/dense/extreme.
gate.extreme_individual_protection: Every one of seven extreme absolute errors protected against all protection references.
gate.displacement: Same gains/protections for ordered_matched_centered against five matched full/mean/summary components.

resource_policy.shared_GPU: Explicit owner approval retained for this bounded test

limitations: One disposable late-optimizer update per input, not a32-step replay or a learning curve.
The original trained32-step endpoint weights were discarded; this probe cannot reconstruct their decomposition.
Centered inference interventions are not evidence that training through centering converges.
All65 fitting readouts are reused and seen by checkpoint; no new validation or novelty claim.
Negative signs are diagnostic only; no posthoc winner or inference count multiplier.
subsequent_action: Owner authorizes full training after a protected passed primary gate. On pass, freeze the trainable centered recipe, fair control and full budget and pass native gradient/recovery guards before launch. On failed/unevaluable gate, report blocker; do not launch an unsupported full run or switch primary.

decomposition.mean: FP32 spatial mean over unchanged native matching grid, separately per image, level, active exemplar and output channel; no object mask.
decomposition.centered: Original FP32 residual minus its mean. Cast back to original dtype before decoder; record BF16 mean leakage, do not claim exact postcast zero mean or preserved final counts.
decomposition.negative_signs: Fixed diagnostic controls, not alternative candidates.
decomposition.norm_tolerance_reason: New activation-domain check after BF16 quantization (unit roundoff0.00390625); native model/recovery tolerances unchanged.
decomposition.inactive_exemplars: Excluded using supplied exemplar-validity mask; no semantic target masks.
decomposition.zero_norm: No arbitrary epsilon renormalization; mark comparison scientifically unevaluable.

engineering_correction.prior: Preserved v1 CPU-derived norm target failed CUDA no-amplification guard before any Adam call.
engineering_correction.change: Preflight computes matched targets independently in CPU and CUDA; two extra read-only GPUFP32 batch forwards. Scientific implementation, controls, gate and optimizer budget unchanged.
